data.one_liner: A Dart library interfacing with the latest Telegram Bot API.
data.what_it_does: TeleDart is a client library for creating Telegram bots using the Telegram Bot API. It allows developers to handle messages, commands, inline queries, and manage bot events via Dart streams.
use_when: You want to build a Telegram bot in Dart
You prefer stream-based handling of Telegram messages and bot commands
avoid_when: You are building apps for platforms other than Telegram
You need a backend client for services other than Telegram
strengths: Clean and easy implementation of the Telegram Bot API
Supports latest Telegram Bot API versions
weaknesses: GPL-3.0 license may not suit all projects
data.setup_notes: Requires a bot token from @BotFather on Telegram.
